faqs.question: Can I study medicine in Europe from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Possible at real universities with heavy costs and recognition planning — not via fake seat guarantees.

body:
Answer: Medical pathways in Europe can work but are high-cost and high-scrutiny. Recognition for later practice is not automatic. Avoid agents selling “guaranteed MBBS seats” without verifiable universities.

Questions before you deposit

  • Is the university recognized for your long-term licence goals?
  • What is the language of instruction and clinical years?
  • What is the refund policy in writing?
  • Can SK verify the offer domain and fee schedule?

Evidence standard before you spend

For anything related to medical, study, europe, pakistan, keep proofs that a third party can verify: offers on letterhead, bank PDFs with history, attestation receipts, and language results that match the program. Screenshots without context are not a file. If a seller asks you to hide a refusal, change the topic — that is not how SK Immigration works.

  • Offer/contract names match the passport spelling
  • Language rule is printed (IELTS score, MOI, German level, etc.)
  • Funds story matches 3–6 months of statements where missions care about history
  • Attestation order is destination-correct (Apostille vs MOFA paths are not toys)
  • Official mission or university pages were opened the same week you pay

Mistakes we see on “medical study europe pakistan” files

  • Treating “medical study europe pakistan” as a slogan instead of a document checklist
  • Transferring deposits before CUIN and written fee scope are confirmed
  • Copy-pasting another student’s SOP or bank story
  • Hiring anyone who sells a guaranteed visa outcome
